name: proven
description: Root shortcuts only: each folder keeps its own dependencies. The relay installs first because agent/ and web/ import its chain code.

scripts.setup: (cd relay && npm ci) && (cd agent && npm ci) && (cd web && npm ci)
scripts.test: (cd relay && npm test && npm run typecheck) && (cd agent && npm test && npm run typecheck) && (cd web && npm test && npm run typecheck)
